verdict.rationale: Reflect's own docs confirm [[ wiki-style linking (with auto-creation of missing notes) and backlinks, described as a list of incoming links from other notes, plus search filtering by backlinks. Nothing in the evidence covers unlinked mentions, or shows backlinks displayed with surrounding context. missing for 10: unlinked-mention detection, backlinks shown in context, independent hands-on corroboration of the backlinks panel

support.subject: As a researcher, I can link notes with [[wiki-style]] links and see every backlink and unlinked mention of a note in context

citations.quote: Generally note-taking tools, including Reflect, use the `[[` shortcut to link some text.
Backlinks are just a list of incoming links from other notes.
If you link a note that doesn't already yet exist, it'll be auto-created.
